Benzos Revisited
I'm not new to benzodiazepines, I was about 15 years ago a benzo freak for about some years.
My life has changed and recently I felt that I could use some drugs to relax so I began thinking what was the best benzo for me now. I chose bromazepam, and made my way to get it.
I chose bromazepam because I want to feel the anxiety go away but without to much sedation, and bromazepam is even euphoric, in a benzo kinda of way. At least it improves my mood in constrast to diazepam/clonazepam and several other benzos.
Bromazepam its quite like diazepam but without the sedation (in low doses) and kinda stimulates the anxiety free brain to do things.
